correction: Physical posted study booklets remain part of at least this provider’s course offer in a brochure datedMarch2026. However, the same course has online lectures/webinars, online assessments and digital materials. Its existence disproves disappearance of postal components, but cannot by itself disprove disappearance of exclusively postal teaching.

limits: Does not establish the market share of postal teaching, that a postal-only course still exists, that the law fits digital offerings, or that the repeal request is wrong. Do not promote mere semantic disagreement to proved factual error. The brochure carries aMarch2026copyright date and was retrieved after the Septemberauthor; its pre-author public availability has not been independently archived.
